State Farm is slow-walking the payout of insurance claims for Missourians who lost their homes to devastating tornadoes 

I am furthering my investigation. 

Missourians’ claims need to be paid IN FULL

Hawley introduces bill to strip congressional pensions following sex crime convictions 

foxnews.com/politics/sex-cri…
If reconciliation doesn’t include a ban on federal money for Planned Parenthood, I’ll offer an amendment to ban it

Great to be with my friend @albertmohler and so many young believers at @BoyceCollege @SBTS today

God wants to use the next generation to bring about REVIVAL in America

Right now, members of Congress can be convicted of sexual abuse and still receive their pension. 

I’m introducing legislation to end that
